verdict.rationale: replica-skill is a set of Claude Code skills and local standard-library Python scripts. It writes its outputs to a local `replica/` folder in the user's project, and its scripts don't touch the network. It runs no hosted storage service of its own, so choosing a storage region or residency is a category error for this kind of product. Where Claude itself processes data is a host-platform matter and is not credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
